in_marathi.name: Ridhav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the hills
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ridhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ridhav is a Sanskrit name, derived from the root words 'Ridh' which means 'Lord' and 'Hav' which means 'Hills'. This name signifies the one who rules over the hills or the one who is a protector of the mountains.
